title: SocketOpenedPayload

clientSessionId.description: A client session's id, as hello names it and the access methods list and revoke it.

socketId.description: The socket's id, the same on its opened and closed events.

remoteAddress.description: The address the socket came from, when known: behind the web origin's proxy, the address it forwarded.

login.description: The Tailscale login the web origin's proxy named, when it named one.

description: socket.opened: a WebSocket authenticated as the client session.
